articles.title: Father Collapses After Dropping 3-Year-Old Daughter, Dies in Bulandshahr
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Bulandshahr: A heart-wrenching incident has come to light from Syana Kotwali road in Uttar Pradesh’s Bulandshahr district, where a 40-year-old man collapsed and died under suspicious circumstances moments after dropping his three-year-old daughter at school.

body.html:
Bulandshahr: A heart-wrenching incident has come to light from Syana Kotwali road in Uttar Pradesh’s Bulandshahr district, where a 40-year-old man collapsed and died under suspicious circumstances moments after dropping his three-year-old daughter at school. The incident, captured on the school’s CCTV camera, has gone viral on social media.

The deceased has been identified as Tariq Mewati, a resident of Bulandshahr. On Saturday morning, he had gone as usual to drop his daughter at the school gate. CCTV footage shows Tariq getting down from an e-rickshaw, holding his daughter’s hand and school bag, and escorting her inside the gate.

As he turned back to leave after seeing her enter the school, Tariq suddenly collapsed on the road outside the gate. Seeing him fall, nearby people rushed to the spot and informed his family members. He was taken to a nearby private hospital, where doctors provided first aid and referred him to a higher centre after noting his critical condition.

His family then rushed him to another hospital, but Tariq died on the way.

The video of the incident has spread widely on social media and has left viewers deeply moved. In the footage, Tariq is seen sharing what turned out to be his final moments with his young daughter, unaware that it would be their last meeting.

The family is inconsolable. Further details about the cause of death are awaited. #Bulandshahr #UttarPradesh #ViralVideo #HeartWrenching #SchoolGateTragedy #IndianNews

articles.title: Detained Man Sprints Away from Police Vehicle in MP, Video Goes Viral
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Bhopal/Hoshangabad: A bizarre incident of a detained man escaping from police custody has gone viral on social media, leaving both police personnel and netizens stunned.

body.html:
Bhopal/Hoshangabad: A bizarre incident of a detained man escaping from police custody has gone viral on social media, leaving both police personnel and netizens stunned. The dramatic escape, reminiscent of a Bollywood action scene, is believed to have taken place on the outskirts of Hoshangabad in Madhya Pradesh, though the exact location is yet to be officially confirmed.

The widely circulated video shows a police vehicle parked on the roadside, with a few policemen apparently engaged in repair work. In the meantime, the accused is seen calmly opening the gate of the vehicle, spotting a clear passage and suddenly breaking into a sprint, barefoot, along the road.

Despite attempts by the policemen to chase him, they failed to catch up, allowing the man to vanish from the spot. Commuters and onlookers at the scene appeared amused and astonished by the unexpected turn of events, with several capturing the moment on their mobile phones.

The high-speed escape on a public road looked more like a movie sequence than a routine police operation, prompting social media users to flood the comment sections with jokes and memes. Many remarked that the scene only lacked slow motion shots and dramatic dialogues to complete the ‘filmy’ effect.

The incident has triggered widespread curiosity, with netizens urging the Madhya Pradesh Police to clarify the circumstances behind the escape. Questions are being raised about whether the man was a serious criminal and whether he was later recaptured.

So far, the police have not issued any official statement on the matter. Further details are awaited.

articles.title: Fake Bride, Real Betrayal: Groom Duped of ₹1.25 Lakh in Indore Court Marriage Scam
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Indore: A shocking case of marriage fraud has come to light at the Indore District Court premises, where a young man was allegedly duped of ₹1.25 lakh in the name of a court marriage.

body.html:
Indore: A shocking case of marriage fraud has come to light at the Indore District Court premises, where a young man was allegedly duped of ₹1.25 lakh in the name of a court marriage. The MG Road police have arrested a fake bride and her accomplice posing as her brother, while two other accused are absconding.

According to the complaint lodged by Sunil Barodiya (28), a resident of Sagaur in Dhar district, he was contacted over the phone by a man named Ajay Joshi, who claimed to be a priest and offered to arrange his marriage. Ajay sent him a photograph of a young woman and lured him with the promise of an immediate court marriage.

As per the plan, Sunil and his family reached the Indore District Court for notarisation of the marriage. There, a woman identified as Sapna Ahirwar, a resident of Sagar, arrived posing as the bride, accompanied by Ravi Raghuvanshi of Vidisha, who introduced himself as her brother. Another accused, Rajesh Gaur, posed as her uncle.

During the ceremony in the court premises, Sunil was allegedly extorted of ₹1.20 to ₹1.25 lakh in the name of marriage expenses. After taking the money, Ajay Joshi and Rajesh Gaur fled the spot, promising to return shortly. When they did not come back and their phones were found switched off, Sunil grew suspicious.

On being questioned, Sapna revealed that she was already married and a mother of a child. She admitted that Ajay had asked her to pose as a bride in exchange for money.

Sunil immediately approached the MG Road police station. Acting swiftly, the police reached the spot and apprehended Sapna Ahirwar and Ravi Raghuvanshi. Both are currently being interrogated.

Additional DCP Ramsnehi Mishra said a case of cheating and fraud has been registered against Ravi Raghuvanshi, Sapna Ahirwar, Ajay Joshi and Rajesh Gaur. Efforts are on to trace and arrest the absconding accused.

Police have warned people to remain cautious of marriage offers made through unknown callers and brokers, especially when money is demanded in advance.

articles.title: Sunbath Turns Fatal: Dumper Overturns on 90-Year-Old in Gwalior, CCTV Horror Caught on Camera
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Gwalior: A tragic accident claimed the life of a 90-year-old man after a dumper loaded with gravel overturned on him in Madhya Pradesh’s Gwalior. The incident, which occurred in Aarnav Colony under the Bahodapur police station area, was captured on a nearby CCTV camera.

body.html:
Gwalior: A tragic accident claimed the life of a 90-year-old man after a dumper loaded with gravel overturned on him in Madhya Pradesh’s Gwalior. The incident, which occurred in Aarnav Colony under the Bahodapur police station area, was captured on a nearby CCTV camera.

The deceased has been identified as Girraj Sharma. He was sitting outside his house and sunbathing, as was his daily routine, when the dumper passing through the road suddenly lost balance and toppled over him. He died on the spot after being crushed under the heavy vehicle.

According to the police, potholes dug during road work in the area had not been properly filled by the contractor. As the dumper’s tyres sank into these pits, the vehicle tilted to one side and overturned in the direction where the elderly man was sitting.

Following the accident, panic spread in the locality. Residents rushed to the spot, but Sharma had already succumbed to his injuries. The dumper driver abandoned the vehicle and fled from the scene.

On receiving information, Bahodapur police reached the spot, seized the dumper and sent the body for post-mortem examination. A case has been registered against the absconding driver, and efforts are on to trace him.

The CCTV footage shows the dumper suddenly tilting and, within moments, falling on the elderly man. Local residents have expressed anger over the incident, alleging that road excavation work has been going on for a long time without adequate safety measures. They have demanded strict action against those responsible.

articles.title: ID Card Triggered Rage: Traffic Cop Slaps Woman on Ahmedabad Road, Video Sparks Outrage
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Ahmedabad: A traffic police officer allegedly slapped a young woman after a heated argument over his identity card on a public road in the Bhattha area near Anjali Crossroads in Gujarat’s Ahmedabad.

body.html:
Ahmedabad: A traffic police officer allegedly slapped a young woman after a heated argument over his identity card on a public road in the Bhattha area near Anjali Crossroads in Gujarat’s Ahmedabad.

According to the complaint, the incident occurred on December 19 when the woman, identified as Bansari Thakkar, a resident of Vasna, was stopped at a junction for a driving licence check. While she was searching for her licence, she asked the on-duty officer to show his ID card.

Police sources said the officer, later identified as Jayanti Zala, showed his card. While returning it, the card accidentally fell to the ground, which reportedly angered him. It is alleged that he grabbed Bansari’s hand, kicked her vehicle, used abusive language and slapped her multiple times, causing injuries to her eye, ear and cheek.

Eyewitnesses said a crowd gathered as the situation escalated. In a video of the incident that has gone viral, the officer is also seen attempting to strike her with a baton, before being stopped by other police personnel.

Distressed, Bansari called the emergency helpline 112 and later went to the Paldi Police Station to lodge a complaint. She has alleged that she was initially refused and threatened with a counter-complaint by police personnel, including a woman officer. Eventually, she submitted a written application at around 11.50 pm.

Police said that as the matter involved traffic duty, she was advised to approach the traffic police. The Paldi police later stated that since there was an altercation between both sides, cross-complaints were registered.

While the woman alleged assault by the officer, police also registered a case against her for allegedly driving without a licence. Based on the video footage, an inquiry has been initiated into the conduct of the officer.

The incident has once again brought Ahmedabad’s traffic police under scrutiny, raising questions over the conduct of personnel on public duty and the safety of citizens, especially women.

articles.title: Defeat Turns Violent: Congress Candidate Blocks Road with Thorny Bushes, Stones Pelted at Police
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Adilabad: Tension prevailed in Chinna Buggaaram Gram Panchayat of Neradigonda mandal in Adilabad district after a Congress-backed sarpanch candidate allegedly blocked a village road with thorny bushes and her family members attacked police with stones following her defeat in the panchayat...

body.html:
Adilabad: Tension prevailed in Chinna Buggaaram Gram Panchayat of Neradigonda mandal in Adilabad district after a Congress-backed sarpanch candidate allegedly blocked a village road with thorny bushes and her family members attacked police with stones following her defeat in the panchayat elections.

In the elections, BRS candidate Ujwal Jadhav defeated Congress-backed candidate Chandrakala. Alleging foul play and expressing anger over the defeat, Chandrakala’s family members placed thorny bushes on the road in front of their house and declared that no one should pass through that route.

After villagers informed the police, personnel reached the spot and tried to remove the thorny bushes to restore traffic. At this point, Chandrakala’s family members, along with the Congress sarpanch candidate, allegedly attacked the police team by pelting stones.

In the incident, a sub-inspector and a few constables sustained injuries.

Police are investigating the incident and further action is expected.

articles.title: Love, Case and Poison: Hapur Man’s Death Sparks Hospital Chaos, Slippers Fly as Video Goes Viral
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Hapur: A 27-year-old man allegedly consumed poison at the house of his married girlfriend in the Garhmukteshwar police station area of Hapur district on Thursday, leading to his death during treatment and a dramatic scene at a government health centre.

body.html:
Hapur: A 27-year-old man allegedly consumed poison at the house of his married girlfriend in the Garhmukteshwar police station area of Hapur district on Thursday, leading to his death during treatment and a dramatic scene at a government health centre.

The deceased, identified as Rinku, a resident of the main market area of Garhmukteshwar, had been in a relationship with the woman for about five years. The woman has been living separately from her husband for several years following a dispute, the family alleged.

According to police, Rinku reached the woman’s house between 12 pm and 1 pm on Thursday. After an argument, he allegedly consumed a poisonous substance. When foam started coming out of his mouth, the woman and her family rushed him to a nearby private hospital, from where he was referred to the Central Health Centre (CHC) on Hapur-Garh Road. Rinku died during treatment at the CHC.

Using Rinku’s mobile phone, the woman informed his family about his condition. On receiving the news of his death, family members rushed to the CHC. His mother, in a state of shock, accused the woman of ruining her son’s life by filing a false case and alleged that she had forced him to take poison. In a fit of rage, family members beat the woman with slippers and slapped her inside the hospital परिसर. Police personnel, who reached the spot after being informed, intervened and rescued the woman.

A video of the assault inside the CHC has since gone viral on social media.

The family alleged that the woman had been extorting money from Rinku and threatening him for years. About two years ago, she had filed a r*pe case against him, following which he was arrested. He was later released as the medical report did not confirm the allegation. After the case, Rinku was allegedly evicted from his home by his family.

The woman, however, claimed that when Rinku arrived at her house on Thursday, she was not present and that she did not assault him at the hospital.

Circle Officer Stuti Singh said the body has been taken into custody and sent for postmortem. “No written complaint has been received so far from the family of the deceased. The matter is being investigated from all angles. Further action will be taken based on the postmortem report,” she said.

Police said the incident occurred about 40 km from the district headquarters and that the case will be probed once a formal complaint is lodged.
